meaning:
ὅρασις, -εως, ἡ
(ὁράω) [in LXX chiefly for מַרְאֶה, חָזוֹן and cognate forms ;]
1. in Arist. and later writers, the act of seeing, the sense of sight, and by meton., pl., the eyes.
2. appearance (Num.24:4, Eze.1:5, Sir.41:20, al.): Rev.4:3.
3. = ὅραμα, a vision: Act.2:17 (LXX), Rev.9:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see…
that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
